data.title: I wired 4 models together in Claude Code. It backfired 4 ways on Terminal-Bench - Quesma Blog
data.description: Common wisdom says to put a strong model like Fable in charge and let cheaper models do the work. I tested it and the result was not what I expected: seventh place at twice the cost of the top single-model run.
data.author: Bartosz Kotrys
data.keywords: orchestration, model orchestration, llm orchestration, terminal-bench, claude code, ai agents, ai agent costs, tokenomics, token economy, benchmarks, claude
